optimality: The policies use forbidden runtime future knowledge. Counts are achievable clairvoyant upper bounds on the minimum misses, not proven grouped-pin optimal minima. Compulsory first touches give a separate lower bound. Failure rejects the selected same-policy screen, not all possible global architectures.
